project_type: Python scraper/knowledge-base project with GitHub Actions CI
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, no Makefile or build system beyond pip install
test_framework: pytest (scripts/tests/ directory, test files use pytest fixtures and classes)
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps: pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt. 2. Run pytest: python -m pytest scripts/tests/ -v. 3. Run validate_content.py with a test directory containing small JSON files with 'results' key to confirm they pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. GitHub Power available for push/PR.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md with specific rules beyond standard practices.
key_patterns: Scrapers (fetch_cbosa.py, fetch_curia.py) save per-keyword JSON with format {"keyword": "...", "results": [...]}. Summary files (cbosa_wyniki.json, curia_wyniki.json) use a different format (dict of keyword -> results list). validate_content.py checks all .json/.md/.html files for MIN_FILE_SIZE=100 bytes. Tests live in scripts/tests/ and use pytest classes, mocks, and tmp_path fixtures.
directory_structure: scripts/ - Python scrapers and validate_content.py; scripts/tests/ - pytest tests; .github/workflows/ - CI workflow; orzecznictwo/ - court decisions output; output/ - fetched data output
